# Reference

<!-- purpose: Where to look up a key, a command, a check or a tool, page by page -->

*This page is generated from SWCraft's own definitions, and describes the version you have installed.*

The pages in this section list what SWCraft accepts and what it does, exhaustively. They are the place to look up a key, a command or a check; the pages outside this section are the place to learn how the pieces fit together.

| Page | What it lists |
|---|---|
| [The model layers](model/index.md) | Every layer of the model, and for each one every kind of element and every key it accepts. |
| [The checks](rules.md) | Every check SWCraft runs over a project, what each one requires and which layers it reads. |
| [The command line](cli.md) | Every `swcraft` command, every option it accepts and what it does when you leave it out. |
| [The requirements interchange file](requirements-interchange.md) | The schema of the file `swcraft import requirements` reads, for checking a converter's output. |
| [The model passport](model-passport.md) | The schema of the file `swcraft passport` writes, the shape of a model without its names. |
| [The assistant's tools](tools.md) | Every tool the assistant can call, with the arguments it fills in for each one. |
